result.stdout:
upgrademap — know what breaks before you migrate

USAGE
  upgrademap scan <path-to-sln-or-directory> [options]

COMMANDS
  scan            Inventory a solution: projects, frameworks, waves,
                  blockers, package verdicts

OPTIONS
  --report [path] Write the full HTML upgrade map
                  (default: <SolutionName>.upgrademap.html)
  --json          Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the console summary
  --offline       Skip the nuget.org compatibility check (only package IDs
                  are ever sent; your code never leaves the machine either way)
  -h, --help      Show this help

EXAMPLES
  upgrademap scan .
  upgrademap scan ./Legacy.sln --report
  upgrademap scan ./Legacy.sln --json > upgrade.json

https://github.com/dev-tayyab/upgrademap
